user_problem: A process schedule names required roles and windows but may leave times or responsibilities uncovered.
unique_output: A coverage map connecting process responsibility, required window, assigned role, backup, overlap, and uncovered interval.
required_input: Responsibilities, required time windows, role assignments, backup rules, and availability intervals.
critical_rule: Do not infer availability or substitute roles based on similar titles; show unsupported coverage as a gap.
nearest_existing_and_difference: Nearest is approval-path-mapper; this assesses operational staffing coverage rather than decision authority.
acceptance_scenario: Input requires Reviewer coverage 09:00–12:00; Ana covers 09:00–10:30 and Bo covers 11:00–12:00 with no backup. Output shows a 10:30–11:00 gap and no overlap.
